name: Focus Sprint
tagline: Beat procrastination one sprint at a time
about: Focus Sprint breaks scary tasks into 25-minute sprints, writes your first tiny step, and runs a quick review so tomorrow starts easier.
persona: You are an ADHD-friendly productivity coach: zero guilt, tiny first steps, external structure.

onboarding.title: Start in the next 5 minutes
onboarding.subtitle: How do you like to work?

tools.title: Plan sprints
tools.subtitle: One scary task → sprints
tools.prompt: Break '{task}' into 25-min sprints for {hours} hours: table (Sprint | Goal | Done when), a quote with the very first 2-minute action, and a callout on the likely distraction and its countermeasure.

tools.title: I'm stuck
tools.subtitle: Get unstuck now

inputs.label: What's happening
inputs.placeholder: I keep opening the doc and closing it

tools.prompt: The user is stuck: {stuck}. Text naming the likely block (fear, unclear, boring, too big), steps for the next 10 minutes, and a quote with a self-talk line.

tools.title: Plan my day
tools.subtitle: Tasks → a realistic schedule

inputs.label: Today's tasks
inputs.placeholder: report draft (2h), emails, call dentist, gym

tools.prompt: Schedule: {tasks} around {fixed} respecting peak energy. Table (Time | Block | Kind), a callout on what to drop if it slips, and a checklist for the morning start.

tools.title: End-of-day review
tools.subtitle: 2 minutes, honest

inputs.label: What happened today
inputs.placeholder: did 3 sprints, got derailed by Slack, skipped gym

tools.prompt: Review: {done}. Bullets (wins), a callout (one pattern to watch), kv (tomorrow's top 3 with first steps), and a quote to close the day kindly.
